Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE 27 May 2010 MR. GLICERIO G. EDANG OPINION NO. 64 S. 2mo Sangguniang Bayan Member Sibunag, Guimaras Dear Sir: This pertains to your letter seeking our legal opinion relative to Resolution No. 067-S-2009 of the Municipality of Sibunag. Per your letter, on 16 September 2009, the Sangguniang Bayan conducted a regular session attended by all members. In said regular session, they presented for consideration on the second reading the t'Resolution Authorizing the Municipal Mayor Hon. Pedrito V. Gange to Negotiate-a Contract of Loan with the Land Bank of the Philippines for the procurement of two (2) units HD-160, 6-wheeler Hyundai dump tracks. Accordingly, after sufficient time was given for debate or discussion, the question was put to a vote, the result was: five (5) members voted in the affirmative, four (4) members voted in the negative, and one (1) member abstained. Thereafter, the presiding officer declared the Resolution passed/approved on second and final reading. This was further attested by the Vice Mayor and approved by the Mayor. In reply thereto, please be informed that since Resolution No. 067-S-2009 of the Municipality of Sibunag has undergone the procedural process for its passage under the Local Government Code, the same is considered valid unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issue or question thereon as to the substantive validity and enforceability of the said Resolution should be threshed out by filing a special civil action for declaratory relief before the proper court in accordance with Section I, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provides and we quote: "Section I. Who may file petition.- Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written

-2- instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional Trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder." Hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: . JESUS . DOQ V Director Ill cop urnished: Director Evelyn A. Trompeta DILG Regional Office No. VI Fort San Pedro, Iloilo City
